Makefile.coq: _CoqProject Makefile
	rocq makefile -f _CoqProject $(LIBRARY_FLAGS) -o Makefile.coq

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.base.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.syntax.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.semantics.

Import syntax.notations.

Import semantics.notations.

Implicit Types (b : bool) (x X y Y : atom) (L : aset).

Variant kind :=
| KAny
| KPublic
| KObliv
| KMixed
.

Instance kind_join : Join kind :=
  fun κ1 κ2 =>
    match κ1, κ2 with
    | KAny, κ | κ, KAny => κ
    | KPublic, KObliv | KObliv, KPublic => KMixed
    | KMixed, _ | _, KMixed => KMixed
    | κ, _ => κ
    end.

Instance kind_le : SqSubsetEq kind :=
  fun κ1 κ2 => κ2 = (κ1 ⊔ κ2).

Instance kind_top : Top kind := KMixed.

Instance kind_bot : Bottom kind := KAny.

Notation tctx := (amap lexpr).

Module kind_notations.

Notation "*@A" := (KAny) (in custom oadt at level 0).

Notation "*@P" := (KPublic) (in custom oadt at level 0).

Notation "*@O" := (KObliv) (in custom oadt at level 0).

Notation "*@M" := (KMixed) (in custom oadt at level 0).

Infix "⊔" := (⊔) (in custom oadt at level 50).

End kind_notations.

Section typing.

Import kind_notations.

#[local]
Coercion EFVar : atom >-> expr.

Section fix_gctx.

Context (Σ : gctx).

Reserved Notation "e '⇛' e'" (at level 40,
                                 e' constr at level 0).

Inductive pared : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
| RApp l τ e1 e2 e1' e2' L :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    lc τ ->
    <{ (\:{l}τ => e2) e1 }> ⇛ <{ e2'^e1' }>
| RFun x T e :
    Σ !! x = Some (DFun T e) ->
    <{ gvar x }> ⇛ <{ e }>
| ROADT X τ' τ e e' :
    Σ !! X = Some (DOADT τ' τ) ->
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ (gvar X) e }> ⇛ <{ τ^e' }>
| RLet e1 e2 e1' e2' L :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    <{ let e1 in e2 }> ⇛ <{ e2'^e1' }>
| RProj b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ π@b (e1, e2) }> ⇛ <{ ite b e1' e2' }>
| RFold X X' e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ unfold<X> (fold<X'> e) }> ⇛ e'
| RIf b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ if b then e1 else e2 }> ⇛ <{ ite b e1' e2' }>
| RCase b τ e0 e1 e2 e0' e1' e2' L1 L2 :
    e0 ⇛ e0' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <{ e1^x }> ⇛ <{ e1'^x }>) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    lc τ ->
    <{ case inj@b<τ> e0 of e1 | e2 }> ⇛ <{ ite b (e1'^e0') (e2'^e0') }>

| RMux b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ mux [b] e1 e2 }> ⇛ <{ ite b e1' e2' }>
| RSec b :
    <{ s𝔹 b }> ⇛ <{ [b] }>
| ROInj b ω v :
    otval ω -> oval v ->
    <{ ~inj@b<ω> v }> ⇛ <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>

| ROIf b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ ~if [b] then e1 else e2 }> ⇛ <{ ite b e1' e2' }>
| ROCase b ω1 ω2 v v1 v2 e1 e2 e1' e2' L1 L2 :
    oval v ->
    ovalty v1 ω1 -> ovalty v2 ω2 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <{ e1^x }> ⇛ <{ e1'^x }>) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    <{ ~case [inj@b<ω1 ~+ ω2> v] of e1 | e2 }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then (ite b (e1'^v) (e1'^v1)) else (ite b (e2'^v2) (e2'^v)) }>

| ROIfApp b e1 e2 e e1' e2' e' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ (~if [b] then e1 else e2) e }> ⇛ <{ ~if [b] then e1' e' else e2' e' }>
| ROIfSec b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ s𝔹 (~if [b] then e1 else e2) }> ⇛ <{ ~if [b] then s𝔹 e1' else s𝔹 e2' }>
| ROIfIf b e1 e2 e3 e4 e1' e2' e3' e4' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    e3 ⇛ e3' ->
    e4 ⇛ e4' ->
    <{ if (~if [b] then e1 else e2) then e3 else e4 }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then (if e1' then e3' else e4') else (if e2' then e3' else e4') }>
| ROIfProj b b' e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ π@b' (~if [b] then e1 else e2) }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then π@b' e1' else π@b' e2' }>
| ROIfCase b e1 e2 e3 e4 e1' e2' e3' e4' L1 L2 :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <{ e3^x }> ⇛ <{ e3'^x }>) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <{ e4^x }> ⇛ <{ e4'^x }>) ->
    <{ case (~if [b] then e1 else e2) of e3 | e4 }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then (case e1' of e3' | e4') else (case e2' of e3' | e4') }>
| ROIfUnfold X b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ unfold<X> (~if [b] then e1 else e2) }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then unfold<X> e1' else unfold<X> e2' }>
| RTapeOIf b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ tape (~if [b] then e1 else e2) }> ⇛ <{ mux [b] (tape e1') (tape e2') }>
| RTapePair e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    woval e1 -> woval e2 ->
    <{ tape (e1, e2) }> ⇛ <{ (tape e1', tape e2') }>
| RTapeUnitV :
    <{ tape () }> ⇛ <{ () }>
| RTapeBoxedLit b :
    <{ tape [b] }> ⇛ <{ [b] }>
| RTapeBoxedInj b ω v :
    otval ω -> oval v ->
    <{ tape [inj@b<ω> v] }> ⇛ <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>

| RCgrPi l τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' L :
    τ1 ⇛ τ1' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ τ2^x }> ⇛ <{ τ2'^x }>) ->
    <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> ⇛ <{ Π:{l}τ1', τ2' }>
| RCgrAbs l τ e τ' e' L :
    τ ⇛ τ' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ e^x }> ⇛ <{ e'^x }>) ->
    <{ \:{l}τ => e }> ⇛ <{ \:{l}τ' => e' }>
| RCgrApp e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ e1 e2 }> ⇛ <{ e1' e2' }>
| RCgrLet e1 e2 e1' e2' L :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    <{ let e1 in e2 }> ⇛ <{ let e1' in e2' }>
| RCgrSec e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ s𝔹 e }> ⇛ <{ s𝔹 e' }>
| RCgrIf l e0 e1 e2 e0' e1' e2' :
    e0 ⇛ e0' ->
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> ⇛ <{ if{l} e0' then e1' else e2' }>
| RCgrProd τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' :
    τ1 ⇛ τ1' ->
    τ2 ⇛ τ2' ->
    <{ τ1 * τ2 }> ⇛ <{ τ1' * τ2' }>
| RCgrPair e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ (e1, e2) }> ⇛ <{ (e1', e2') }>
| RCgrProj b e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ π@b e }> ⇛ <{ π@b e' }>
| RCgrSum l τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' :
    τ1 ⇛ τ1' ->
    τ2 ⇛ τ2' ->
    <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> ⇛ <{ τ1' +{l} τ2' }>
| RCgrInj l b τ e τ' e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    τ ⇛ τ' ->
    <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> ⇛ <{ inj{l}@b<τ'> e' }>
| RCgrCase l e0 e1 e2 e0' e1' e2' L1 L2 :
    e0 ⇛ e0' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <{ e1^x }> ⇛ <{ e1'^x }>) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> ⇛ <{ case{l} e0' of e1' | e2' }>
| RCgrFold X e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ fold<X> e }> ⇛ <{ fold<X> e' }>
| RCgrUnfold X e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ unfold<X> e }> ⇛ <{ unfold<X> e' }>
| RCgrMux e0 e1 e2 e0' e1' e2' :
    e0 ⇛ e0' ->
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> ⇛ <{ mux e0' e1' e2' }>
| RCgrTape e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->

| RRefl e :

where "e1 '⇛' e2" := (pared e1 e2)
.

Notation "e '⇛*' e'" := (rtc pared e e')
                            (at level 40,
                             e' custom oadt at level 99).

Inductive pared_equiv : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
| QRRefl e : e ≡ e
| QRRedL e1 e1' e2 :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e1' ≡ e2 ->
    e1 ≡ e2
| QRRedR e1 e2 e2' :
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    e1 ≡ e2' ->
    e1 ≡ e2

where "e ≡ e'" := (pared_equiv e e')
.

Definition pared_equiv_join (e1 e2 : expr) : Prop :=
  exists e, e1 ⇛* e /\ e2 ⇛* e.

Reserved Notation "Γ '⊢' e ':{' l '}' τ" (at level 40,
                                          e custom oadt at level 99,
                                          l constr at level 99,
                                          τ custom oadt at level 99).

Reserved Notation "Γ '⊢' τ '::' κ" (at level 40,
                                    τ custom oadt at level 99,
                                    κ custom oadt at level 99).

Inductive typing : tctx -> expr -> bool -> expr -> Prop :=
| TFVar Γ x l τ κ :
    Γ !! x = Some (l, τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ fvar x :{l} τ
| TUnit Γ : Γ ⊢ () :{⊥} 𝟙
| TLit Γ b : Γ ⊢ lit b :{⊥} 𝔹
| TFun Γ x l τ e :
    Σ !! x = Some (DFun (l, τ) e) ->
    Γ ⊢ gvar x :{l} τ
| TAbs Γ l1 l2 e τ1 τ2 κ L :
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(l2, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e^x :{l1} τ1^x) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ \:{l2}τ2 => e :{l1} (Π:{l2}τ2, τ1)
| TLet Γ l1 l2 l e1 e2 τ1 τ2 L :
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ1 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(l1, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ2^x) ->
    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ let e1 in e2 :{l} τ2^e1
| TApp Γ l1 l2 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} (Π:{l2}τ2, τ1) ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ2 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 e2 :{l1} τ1^e2
| TPair Γ l1 l2 l e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ1 ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ2 ->
    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ (e1, e2) :{l} τ1 * τ2
| TProj Γ l b e τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ1 * τ2 ->
    Γ ⊢ π@b e :{l} ite b τ1 τ2
| TInj Γ l b e τ1 τ2 κ :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} ite b τ1 τ2 ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 + τ2 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ inj@b<τ1 + τ2> e :{l} τ1 + τ2
| TIf Γ l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ κ :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} 𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ^(lit true) ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ^(lit false) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ^e0 :: κ ->
    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ if e0 then e1 else e2 :{l} τ^e0
| TIfNoDep Γ l0 l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{l0} 𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ ->
    l = l0 ⊔ l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ if e0 then e1 else e2 :{l} τ
| TCase Γ l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} τ1 + τ2 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e1^x :{l1} τ^(inl<τ1 + τ2> x)) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ^(inr<τ1 + τ2> x)) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ^e0 :: κ ->
    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ case e0 of e1 | e2 :{l} τ^e0
| TCaseNoDep Γ l0 l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{l0} τ1 + τ2 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(l0, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e1^x :{l1} τ) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(l0, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    l = l0 ⊔ l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ case e0 of e1 | e2 :{l} τ

    Σ !! X = Some (DADT τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ fold<X> e :{l} gvar X
| TUnfold Γ l X e τ :
    Σ !! X = Some (DADT τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} gvar X ->
    Γ ⊢ unfold<X> e :{l} τ
| TSec Γ l e :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} 𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ s𝔹 e :{l} ~𝔹
| TMux Γ e0 e1 e2 τ :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} ~𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{⊥} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{⊥} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ mux e0 e1 e2 :{⊥} τ
| TOInj Γ b e τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e :{⊥} ite b τ1 τ2 ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 ~+ τ2 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ ~inj@b<τ1 ~+ τ2> e :{⊥} τ1 ~+ τ2
| TOIf Γ l1 l2 e0 e1 e2 τ κ :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} ~𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ ~if e0 then e1 else e2 :{⊤} τ
| TOCase Γ l1 l2 e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} τ1 ~+ τ2 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e1^x :{l1} τ) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ ~case e0 of e1 | e2 :{⊤} τ
| TTape Γ l e τ :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ tape e :{⊥} τ

| TBoxedLit Γ b : Γ ⊢ [b] :{⊥} ~𝔹
| TBoxedInj Γ b v ω :
    ovalty <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }> ω ->
    Γ ⊢ [inj@b<ω> v] :{⊥} ω

| TConv Γ l l' e τ τ' κ :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l'} τ' ->
    τ' ≡ τ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    l' ⊑ l ->
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ

with kinding : tctx -> expr -> kind -> Prop :=
| KADT Γ X τ :
    Σ !! X = Some (DADT τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ gvar X :: *@P
| KUnit Γ : Γ ⊢ 𝟙 :: *@A
| KBool Γ l : Γ ⊢ 𝔹{l} :: ite l *@O *@P
| KPi Γ l τ1 τ2 κ1 κ2 L :
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(l, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ τ2^x :: κ2) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ1 ->
    Γ ⊢ (Π:{l}τ1, τ2) :: *@M
| KProd Γ τ1 τ2 κ :
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 * τ2 :: κ
| KSum Γ τ1 τ2 κ :
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 + τ2 :: (κ ⊔ *@P)
| KOSum Γ τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 ~+ τ2 :: *@O
| KOADT Γ e' e τ X :
    Σ !! X = Some (DOADT τ e') ->
    Γ ⊢ e :{⊥} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ (gvar X) e :: *@O
| KIf Γ e0 τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} 𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ if e0 then τ1 else τ2 :: *@O
| KCase Γ e0 τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' L1 L2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} τ1' + τ2' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ1')]>Γ ⊢ τ1^x :: *@O) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ2')]>Γ ⊢ τ2^x :: *@O) ->
    Γ ⊢ case e0 of τ1 | τ2 :: *@O
| KLet Γ e τ τ' L :
    Γ ⊢ e :{⊥} τ' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(⊥, τ')]>Γ ⊢ τ^x :: *@O) ->
    Γ ⊢ let e in τ :: *@O
| KSub Γ τ κ κ' :
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ' ->
    κ' ⊑ κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ

where "Γ '⊢' e ':{' l '}' τ" := (typing Γ e l τ)
  and "Γ '⊢' τ '::' κ" := (kinding Γ τ κ)
.

Notation "Σ ; Γ '⊢' e ':{' l '}' τ" := (typing Σ Γ e l τ)

                                          e custom oadt at level 99,
                                          τ custom oadt at level 99,

Inductive gdef_typing : gctx -> gdef -> Prop :=
| DTADT Σ τ :
    Σ; ∅ ⊢ τ :: *@P ->
    Σ ⊢₁ (DADT τ)
| DTOADT Σ τ e L :
    Σ; ∅ ⊢ τ :: *@P ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> Σ; ({[x:=(⊥, τ)]}) ⊢ e^x :: *@O) ->
    Σ ⊢₁ (DOADT τ e)
| DTFun Σ l τ e κ :
    Σ; ∅ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    Σ; ∅ ⊢ e :{l} τ ->
    Σ ⊢₁ (DFun (l, τ) e)

where "Σ '⊢₁' D" := (gdef_typing Σ D)
.

Definition gctx_typing (Σ : gctx) : Prop :=
  map_Forall (fun _ D => Σ ⊢₁ D) Σ.

Definition program_typing (Σ : gctx) (e : expr) (τ : expr) :=
  gctx_typing Σ /\ Σ; ∅ ⊢ e :{⊥} τ.

Inductive wval : expr -> Prop :=
| WUnitV : wval <{ () }>
| WLit b : wval <{ lit b }>
| WPair v1 v2 : wval v1 -> wval v2 -> wval <{ (v1, v2) }>
| WAbs l τ e : wval <{ \:{l}τ => e }>
| WInj b τ v : wval v -> wval <{ inj@b<τ> v }>
| WFold X v : wval v -> wval <{ fold<X> v }>
| WBoxedLit b : wval <{ [b] }>
| WBoxedInj b ω v : otval ω -> oval v -> wval <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
| WIf b v1 v2 :
    wval v1 -> wval v2 ->
    wval <{ ~if [b] then v1 else v2 }>
.

Inductive woval : expr -> Prop :=
| OWUnitV : woval <{ () }>
| OWBoxedLit b : woval <{ [b] }>
| OWPair v1 v2 : woval v1 -> woval v2 -> woval <{ (v1, v2) }>
| OWBoxedInj b ω v : otval ω -> oval v -> woval <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
| OWIf b v1 v2 :
    woval v1 -> woval v2 ->
    woval <{ ~if [b] then v1 else v2 }>
.

Inductive ovalty : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
| OTUnit : ovalty <{ () }> <{ 𝟙 }>
| OTOBool b : ovalty <{ [b] }> <{ ~𝔹 }>
| OTProd v1 v2 ω1 ω2 :
    ovalty v1 ω1 -> ovalty v2 ω2 ->
    ovalty <{ (v1, v2) }> <{ ω1 * ω2 }>
| OTOSum b v ω1 ω2 :
    ovalty v <{ ite b ω1 ω2 }> ->

    otval <{ ite b ω2 ω1 }> ->
    ovalty <{ [inj@b<ω1 ~+ ω2> v] }> <{ ω1 ~+ ω2 }>
.

Variant ectx : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
| CtxProd1 τ2 : ectx (fun τ1 => <{ τ1 * τ2 }>)
| CtxProd2 ω1 : otval ω1 -> ectx (fun τ2 => <{ ω1 * τ2 }>)
| CtxOSum1 τ2 : ectx (fun τ1 => <{ τ1 ~+ τ2 }>)
| CtxOSum2 ω1 : otval ω1 -> ectx (fun τ2 => <{ ω1 ~+ τ2 }>)
| CtxApp1 v2 : wval v2 -> ectx (fun e1 => <{ e1 v2 }>)
| CtxApp2 e1 : ectx (fun e2 => <{ e1 e2 }>)
| CtxLet e2 : ectx (fun e1 => <{ let e1 in e2 }>)
| CtxSec : ectx (fun e => <{ s𝔹 e }>)
| CtxIf e1 e2 : ectx (fun e0 => <{ if e0 then e1 else e2 }>)
| CtxOIf1 e1 e2 : ectx (fun e0 => <{ ~if e0 then e1 else e2 }>)
| CtxOIf2 v0 e2 : wval v0 -> ectx (fun e1 => <{ ~if v0 then e1 else e2 }>)
| CtxOIf3 v0 v1 : wval v0 -> wval v1 -> ectx (fun e2 => <{ ~if v0 then v1 else e2 }>)
| CtxPair1 e2 : ectx (fun e1 => <{ (e1, e2) }>)
| CtxPair2 v1 : wval v1 -> ectx (fun e2 => <{ (v1, e2) }>)
| CtxProj b : ectx (fun e => <{ π@b e }>)
| CtxInj b τ : ectx (fun e => <{ inj@b<τ> e }>)
| CtxOInj1 b e : ectx (fun τ => <{ ~inj@b<τ> e }>)
| CtxOInj2 b ω : otval ω -> ectx (fun e => <{ ~inj@b<ω> e }>)
| CtxCase e1 e2: ectx (fun e0 => <{ case e0 of e1 | e2 }>)
| CtxOCase e1 e2: ectx (fun e0 => <{ ~case e0 of e1 | e2 }>)
| CtxFold X : ectx (fun e => <{ fold<X> e }>)
| CtxUnfold X : ectx (fun e => <{ unfold<X> e }>)
| CtxTape : ectx (fun e => <{ tape e }>)
| CtxMux1 e1 e2 : ectx (fun e0 => <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }>)
| CtxMux2 v0 e2 : wval v0 -> ectx (fun e1 => <{ mux v0 e1 e2 }>)
| CtxMux3 v0 v1 : wval v0 -> wval v1 -> ectx (fun e2 => <{ mux v0 v1 e2 }>)
.

Variant lectx : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
| LCtxApp v2 : wval v2 -> lectx (fun e1 => <{ e1 v2 }>)
| LCtxSec : lectx (fun e => <{ s𝔹 e }>)
| LCtxIf e1 e2 : lectx (fun e0 => <{ if e0 then e1 else e2 }>)
| LCtxProj b : lectx (fun e => <{ π@b e }>)
| LCtxCase e1 e2: lectx (fun e0 => <{ case e0 of e1 | e2 }>)

.

Context (Σ : gctx).

Inductive step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
| SApp l τ e v :
    wval v ->
    <{ (\:{l}τ => e) v }> -->! <{ e^v }>
| SLet v e :
    wval v ->
    <{ let v in e }> -->! <{ e^v }>
| SIf b e1 e2 :
    <{ if b then e1 else e2 }> -->! <{ ite b e1 e2 }>
| SCase b τ v e1 e2 :
    wval v ->
    <{ case inj@b<τ> v of e1 | e2 }> -->! <{ ite b (e1^v) (e2^v) }>
| SProj b v1 v2 :
    wval v1 -> wval v2 ->
    <{ π@b (v1, v2) }> -->! <{ ite b v1 v2 }>
| SUnfold X X' v :
    wval v ->
    <{ unfold<X> (fold <X'> v) }> -->! v
| SFun x T e :
    Σ !! x = Some (DFun T e) ->
    <{ gvar x }> -->! <{ e }>
| SOADT X τ' τ v :
    wval v ->
    Σ !! X = Some (DOADT τ' τ) ->
    <{ (gvar X) v }> -->! <{ τ^v }>
| SSec b :
    <{ s𝔹 b }> -->! <{ [b] }>
| SOInj b ω v :
    otval ω -> oval v ->
    <{ ~inj@b<ω> v }> -->! <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
| SMux b v1 v2 :
    wval v1 -> wval v2 ->
    <{ mux [b] v1 v2 }> -->! <{ ite b v1 v2 }>

| SOCase b ω1 ω2 v e1 e2 v1 v2 :
    oval v ->
    ovalty v1 ω1 -> ovalty v2 ω2 ->
    <{ ~case [inj@b<ω1 ~+ ω2> v] of e1 | e2 }> -->!
      <{ ~if [b] then (ite b (e1^v) (e1^v1)) else (ite b (e2^v2) (e2^v)) }>
| STapeOIf b v1 v2 :
    woval v1 -> woval v2 ->
    <{ tape (~if [b] then v1 else v2) }> -->! <{ mux [b] (tape v1) (tape v2) }>
| STapePair v1 v2 :
    woval v1 -> woval v2 ->
    <{ tape (v1, v2) }> -->! <{ (tape v1, tape v2) }>

| STapeUnitV :
    <{ tape () }> -->! <{ () }>
| STapeBoxedLit b :
    <{ tape [b] }> -->! <{ [b] }>
| STapeBoxedInj b ω v :
    otval ω -> oval v ->
    <{ tape [inj@b<ω> v] }> -->! <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
| SOIf b v1 v2 ℇ :
    lectx ℇ ->
    wval v1 -> wval v2 ->
    ℇ <{ ~if [b] then v1 else v2 }> -->! <{ ~if [b] then ,(ℇ v1) else ,(ℇ v2) }>

| SCtx ℇ e e' :
    ectx ℇ ->
    e -->! e' ->
    ℇ e -->! ℇ e'

where "e '-->!' e'" := (step e e').

End step.

Inductive indistinguishable : expr -> expr -> Prop :=

| IFVar x : <{ fvar x }> ≈ <{ fvar x }>
| IGVar x : <{ gvar x }> ≈ <{ gvar x }>
| IPi l τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
    τ1 ≈ τ1' ->
    τ2 ≈ τ2' ->
    <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> ≈ <{ Π:{l}τ1', τ2' }>
| IAbs l τ τ' e e' :
    τ ≈ τ' ->
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ \:{l}τ => e }> ≈ <{ \:{l}τ' => e' }>
| IApp e1 e1' e2 e2' :
    e1 ≈ e1' ->
    e2 ≈ e2' ->
    <{ e1 e2 }> ≈ <{ e1' e2' }>
| ILet e1 e1' e2 e2' :
    e1 ≈ e1' ->
    e2 ≈ e2' ->
    <{ let e1 in e2 }> ≈ <{ let e1' in e2' }>
| IUnitT : <{ 𝟙 }> ≈ <{ 𝟙 }>
| IUnitV : <{ () }> ≈ <{ () }>
| IBool l : <{ 𝔹{l} }> ≈ <{ 𝔹{l} }>
| ILit b : <{ lit b }> ≈ <{ lit b }>
| ISec e e' :
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ s𝔹 e }> ≈ <{ s𝔹 e' }>
| IIte l e0 e0' e1 e1' e2 e2' :
    e0 ≈ e0' ->
    e1 ≈ e1' ->
    e2 ≈ e2' ->
    <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> ≈ <{ if{l} e0' then e1' else e2' }>
| IProd τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
    τ1 ≈ τ1' ->
    τ2 ≈ τ2' ->
    <{ τ1 * τ2 }> ≈ <{ τ1' * τ2' }>
| IPair e1 e1' e2 e2' :
    e1 ≈ e1' ->
    e2 ≈ e2' ->
    <{ (e1, e2) }> ≈ <{ (e1', e2') }>
| IProj b e e' :
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ π@b e }> ≈ <{ π@b e' }>
| ISum l τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
    τ1 ≈ τ1' ->
    τ2 ≈ τ2' ->
    <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> ≈ <{ τ1' +{l} τ2' }>
| IInj l b τ τ' e e' :
    τ ≈ τ' ->
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> ≈ <{ inj{l}@b<τ'> e' }>
| ICase l e0 e0' e1 e1' e2 e2' :
    e0 ≈ e0' ->
    e1 ≈ e1' ->
    e2 ≈ e2' ->
    <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> ≈ <{ case{l} e0' of e1' | e2' }>
| IFold X e e' :
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ fold<X> e }> ≈ <{ fold<X> e' }>
| IUnfold X e e' :
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ unfold<X> e }> ≈ <{ unfold<X> e' }>
| ITape e e' :
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ tape e }> ≈ <{ tape e' }>
| IMux e0 e0' e1 e1' e2 e2' :
    e0 ≈ e0' ->
    e1 ≈ e1' ->
    e2 ≈ e2' ->
    <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> ≈ <{ mux e0' e1' e2' }>

| IBoxedLit b b' :

    <{ [b] }> ≈ <{ [b'] }>
| IBoxedInj b b' τ e e' :

    <{ [inj@b<τ> e] }> ≈ <{ [inj@b'<τ> e'] }>

where "e '≈' e'" := (indistinguishable e e').

Reserved Notation "'{' k '~>' s '}' e" (in custom oadt at level 20, k constr).

Fixpoint open_ (k : nat) (s : expr) (e : expr) : expr :=
  match e with
  | <{ bvar n }> => if decide (k = n) then s else e
  | <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> => <{ Π:{l}({k~>s}τ1), {S k~>s}τ2 }>
  | <{ \:{l}τ => e }> => <{ \:{l}({k~>s}τ) => {S k~>s}e }>
  | <{ let e1 in e2 }> => <{ let {k~>s}e1 in {S k~>s}e2 }>
  | <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> => <{ case{l} {k~>s}e0 of {S k~>s}e1 | {S k~>s}e2 }>

  | <{ e1 e2 }> => <{ ({k~>s}e1) ({k~>s}e2) }>
  | <{ s𝔹 e }> => <{ s𝔹 ({k~>s}e) }>
  | <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> => <{ if{l} {k~>s}e0 then {k~>s}e1 else {k~>s}e2 }>
  | <{ τ1 * τ2 }> => <{ ({k~>s}τ1) * ({k~>s}τ2) }>
  | <{ (e1, e2) }> => <{ ({k~>s}e1, {k~>s}e2) }>
  | <{ π@b e }> => <{ π@b ({k~>s}e) }>
  | <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> => <{ ({k~>s}τ1) +{l} ({k~>s}τ2) }>
  | <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> => <{ inj{l}@b<({k~>s}τ)> ({k~>s}e) }>
  | <{ fold<X> e }> => <{ fold<X> ({k~>s}e) }>
  | <{ unfold<X> e }> => <{ unfold<X> ({k~>s}e) }>
  | <{ tape e }> => <{ tape ({k~>s}e) }>
  | <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> => <{ mux ({k~>s}e0) ({k~>s}e1) ({k~>s}e2) }>
  | _ => e
  end

where "'{' k '~>' s '}' e" := (open_ k s e) (in custom oadt).

Definition open s e := open_ 0 s e.

Notation "e ^ s" := (open s e) (in custom oadt at level 20).

Reserved Notation "'{' x '↦' s '}' e" (in custom oadt at level 20, x constr).

Fixpoint subst (x : atom) (s : expr) (e : expr) : expr :=
  match e with
  | <{ fvar y }> => if decide (x = y) then s else e

  | <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> => <{ Π:{l}({x↦s}τ1), {x↦s}τ2 }>
  | <{ \:{l}τ => e }> => <{ \:{l}({x↦s}τ) => {x↦s}e }>
  | <{ e1 e2 }> => <{ ({x↦s}e1) ({x↦s}e2) }>
  | <{ let e1 in e2 }> => <{ let {x↦s}e1 in {x↦s}e2 }>
  | <{ s𝔹 e }> => <{ s𝔹 ({x↦s}e) }>
  | <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> => <{ if{l} {x↦s}e0 then {x↦s}e1 else {x↦s}e2 }>
  | <{ τ1 * τ2 }> => <{ ({x↦s}τ1) * ({x↦s}τ2) }>
  | <{ (e1, e2) }> => <{ ({x↦s}e1, {x↦s}e2) }>
  | <{ π@b e }> => <{ π@b ({x↦s}e) }>
  | <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> => <{ ({x↦s}τ1) +{l} ({x↦s}τ2) }>
  | <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> => <{ inj{l}@b<({x↦s}τ)> ({x↦s}e) }>
  | <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> => <{ case{l} {x↦s}e0 of {x↦s}e1 | {x↦s}e2 }>
  | <{ fold<X> e }> => <{ fold<X> ({x↦s}e) }>
  | <{ unfold<X> e }> => <{ unfold<X> ({x↦s}e) }>
  | <{ tape e }> => <{ tape ({x↦s}e) }>
  | <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> => <{ mux ({x↦s}e0) ({x↦s}e1) ({x↦s}e2) }>
  | _ => e
  end

where "'{' x '↦' s '}' e" := (subst x s e) (in custom oadt).

Definition lexpr_subst x s (T : lexpr) := (T.1, subst x s T.2).

Inductive otval : expr -> Prop :=
| OVUnitT : otval <{ 𝟙 }>
| OVOBool : otval <{ ~𝔹 }>
| OVProd ω1 ω2 : otval ω1 -> otval ω2 -> otval <{ ω1 * ω2 }>
| OVOSum ω1 ω2 : otval ω1 -> otval ω2 -> otval <{ ω1 ~+ ω2 }>
.

Inductive oval : expr -> Prop :=
| OVUnitV : oval <{ () }>
| OVBoxedLit b : oval <{ [b] }>
| OVPair v1 v2 : oval v1 -> oval v2 -> oval <{ (v1, v2) }>
| OVBoxedInj b ω v : otval ω -> oval v -> oval <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
.

Inductive val : expr -> Prop :=
| VUnitV : val <{ () }>
| VLit b : val <{ lit b }>
| VPair v1 v2 : val v1 -> val v2 -> val <{ (v1, v2) }>
| VAbs l τ e : val <{ \:{l}τ => e }>
| VInj b τ v : val v -> val <{ inj@b<τ> v }>
| VFold X v : val v -> val <{ fold<X> v }>
| VBoxedLit b : val <{ [b] }>
| VBoxedInj b ω v : otval ω -> oval v -> val <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
.

Inductive lc : expr -> Prop :=
| LCFVar x : lc <{ fvar x }>
| LCGVar x : lc <{ gvar x }>
| LCPi l τ1 τ2 L :
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> lc <{ τ2^x }>) ->
    lc τ1 -> lc <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }>
| LCAbs l τ e L :
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> lc <{ e^x }>) ->
    lc τ -> lc <{ \:{l}τ => e }>
| LCLet e1 e2 L :
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> lc <{ e2^x }>) ->
    lc e1 -> lc <{ let e1 in e2 }>
| LCCase l e0 e1 e2 L1 L2 :
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> lc <{ e1^x }>) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> lc <{ e2^x }>) ->
    lc e0 -> lc <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }>

| LCUnitT : lc <{ 𝟙 }>
| LCUnitV : lc <{ () }>
| LCBool l : lc <{ 𝔹{l} }>
| LCApp e1 e2 : lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ e1 e2 }>
| LCLit b : lc <{ lit b }>
| LCSec e : lc e -> lc <{ s𝔹 e }>
| LCIte l e0 e1 e2 : lc e0 -> lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }>
| LCProd τ1 τ2 : lc τ1 -> lc τ2 -> lc <{ τ1 * τ2 }>
| LCPair e1 e2 : lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ (e1, e2) }>
| LCProj b e : lc e -> lc <{ π@b e }>
| LCSum l τ1 τ2 : lc τ1 -> lc τ2 -> lc <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }>
| LCInj l b τ e : lc τ -> lc e -> lc <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }>
| LCFold X e : lc e -> lc <{ fold<X> e }>
| LCUnfold X e : lc e -> lc <{ unfold<X> e }>
| LCTape e : lc e -> lc <{ tape e }>
| LCMux e0 e1 e2 : lc e0 -> lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }>
| LCBoxedLit b : lc <{ [b] }>

| LCBoxedInj b ω v : otval ω -> oval v -> lc <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
.

End definitions.

Notation "{ x '↦' s }" := (lexpr_subst x s) (at level 20).

End notations.

(* A finite-observation model for conversion. Function observations record
   a finite set of input observations and one output observation. *)
Inductive observation :=
| Mark (tag : nat)
| Field (side : bool) (o : observation)
| Arrow (input : list observation) (output : observation)
| Nominal (name : atom).

Definition den := observation -> Prop.
Definition dle (d d' : den) := forall o, d o -> d' o.
Definition deq (d d' : den) := forall o, d o <-> d' o.
Definition dzero : den := fun _ => False.
Definition dlist (xs : list observation) : den := fun o => List.In o xs.
Definition dmark (n : nat) : den := fun o => o = Mark n.
Definition dnominal (x : atom) : den := fun o => o = Nominal x.
Definition dnode (n : nat) (a b : den) : den :=
  fun o => match o with
           | Mark m => m = n
           | Field true p => a p
           | Field false p => b p
           | _ => False
           end.
Definition dfield (s : bool) (d : den) : den := fun o => d (Field s o).
Definition dlam (f : den -> den) : den :=
  fun o => match o with Arrow xs p => f (dlist xs) p | _ => False end.
Definition dapp (f a : den) : den :=
  fun o => exists xs, f (Arrow xs o) /\\ dle (dlist xs) a.
Definition dguard (c : den) (o : observation) (d : den) : den :=
  fun p => c o /\\ d p.
Definition dunion (a b : den) : den := fun o => a o \\/ b o.

Definition dunit := dmark 0.
Definition dbool l := dmark (if l then 2 else 1).
Definition dprod := dnode 3.
Definition dsum l := dnode (if l then 5 else 4).
Definition dpi l := dnode (if l then 7 else 6).
Definition dtype := dmark 8.
Definition dlit b := dmark (if b then 9 else 10).
Definition dpair := dnode 11.
Definition dinj b a := dnode (if b then 9 else 10) a dzero.
Definition dite c a b := dunion (dguard c (Mark 9) a) (dguard c (Mark 10) b).
Definition dcase c f g := dite c (f (dfield true c)) (g (dfield true c)).

Inductive slot := Bound (k : nat) | Free (x : atom) | Global (x : atom).
Definition env := slot -> den.
Definition ele (r s : env) := forall i, dle (r i) (s i).
Definition eeq (r s : env) := forall i, deq (r i) (s i).
Definition push (r : env) (d : den) : env :=
  fun i => match i with
           | Bound 0 => d
           | Bound (S k) => r (Bound k)
           | _ => r i
           end.
Definition ezero : env := fun _ => dzero.
Definition put (r : env) x (d : den) : env :=
  fun i => match i with
           | Free y => if decide (x = y) then d else r i
           | _ => r i
           end.

Fixpoint meaning (r : env) (e : expr) : den :=
  match e with
  | EBVar k => r (Bound k)
  | EFVar x => r (Free x)
  | EGVar x => r (Global x)
  | EUnitT => dunit
  | EBool l => dbool l
  | EProd a b => dprod (meaning r a) (meaning r b)
  | ESum l a b => dsum l (meaning r a) (meaning r b)
  | EPi l a b => dpi l (meaning r a) (dlam (fun d => meaning (push r d) b))
  | EUnitV => dmark 12
  | ELit b | EBoxedLit b => dlit b
  | EAbs _ _ b => dlam (fun d => meaning (push r d) b)
  | EApp f a => dapp (meaning r f) (meaning r a)
  | ELet a b => meaning (push r (meaning r a)) b
  | EIte _ c a b | EMux c a b => dite (meaning r c) (meaning r a) (meaning r b)
  | EPair a b => dpair (meaning r a) (meaning r b)
  | EProj b a => dfield b (meaning r a)
  | EInj _ b _ a | EBoxedInj b _ a => dinj b (meaning r a)
  | ECase _ c a b =>
      dcase (meaning r c) (fun d => meaning (push r d) a)
                         (fun d => meaning (push r d) b)
  | EFold _ a | EUnfold _ a | ESec a | ETape a => meaning r a
  end.

Local Instance deq_equiv : Equivalence deq.
Proof. split; unfold deq; firstorder. Qed.

Local Lemma dle_refl d : dle d d.
Proof. firstorder. Qed.

Local Lemma dle_trans a b c : dle a b -> dle b c -> dle a c.
Proof. firstorder. Qed.

Local Lemma push_le r s a b :
  ele r s -> dle a b -> ele (push r a) (push s b).
Proof. intros Hr H i; destruct i as [[|k]|x|x]; simpl; auto. Qed.

Local Lemma node_le n a b a' b' :
  dle a a' -> dle b b' -> dle (dnode n a b) (dnode n a' b').
Proof. intros Ha Hb [m|[] p|xs p|x]; simpl; auto. Qed.

Local Lemma app_le f a g b :
  dle f g -> dle a b -> dle (dapp f a) (dapp g b).
Proof. intros Hf Ha o (xs & H & Hxs); exists xs; eauto using dle_trans. Qed.

Local Lemma lam_le f g :
  (forall d, dle (f d) (g d)) -> dle (dlam f) (dlam g).
Proof. intros H [n|s o|xs o|x]; simpl; auto. Qed.

Local Lemma field_le b a a' : dle a a' -> dle (dfield b a) (dfield b a').
Proof. firstorder. Qed.

Local Lemma ite_le c a b c' a' b' :
  dle c c' -> dle a a' -> dle b b' -> dle (dite c a b) (dite c' a' b').
Proof. unfold dite, dunion, dguard, dle; firstorder. Qed.

Local Lemma meaning_le e r s : ele r s -> dle (meaning r e) (meaning s e).
Proof.
  revert r s; induction e; intros r s H; cbn [meaning];
    unfold dcase, dprod, dsum, dpi, dinj, dpair;
    eauto 8 using dle_refl, push_le, node_le, app_le, lam_le, field_le, ite_le.
Qed.

Local Lemma deq_le a b : deq a b -> dle a b.
Proof. firstorder. Qed.

Local Lemma eq_of_le a b : dle a b -> dle b a -> deq a b.
Proof. firstorder. Qed.

Local Lemma meaning_eq e r s : eeq r s -> deq (meaning r e) (meaning s e).
Proof.
  intros H; apply eq_of_le; apply meaning_le; intro i;
    apply deq_le; [apply H | symmetry; apply H].
Qed.

Local Lemma push_eq r s a b :
  eeq r s -> deq a b -> eeq (push r a) (push s b).
Proof. intros Hr H i; destruct i as [[|k]|x|x]; simpl; auto. Qed.

Definition directed {I : Type} (R : I -> env) :=
  (exists i, True) /\\ forall i j, exists k, ele (R i) (R k) /\\ ele (R j) (R k).
Definition sup {I : Type} (R : I -> env) : env := fun s o => exists i, R i s o.

Local Lemma directed_collect {I : Type} (R : I -> env) (HD : directed R)
    (F : env -> den) (HM : forall r s, ele r s -> dle (F r) (F s)) xs :
  (forall o, List.In o xs -> exists i, F (R i) o) ->
  exists i, dle (dlist xs) (F (R i)).
Proof.
  destruct HD as [[i _] HD]; induction xs as [|o xs IH]; intros H.
  - exists i; firstorder.
  - destruct (H o) as (j & Hj); [left; reflexivity|].
    destruct IH as (k & Hk); [intros; apply H; right; assumption|].
    destruct (HD j k) as (m & Hjm & Hkm).
    exists m; intros p [<-|Hp]; eauto.
Qed.

Definition continuous (F : env -> den) :=
  forall (I : Type) (R : I -> env), directed R ->
    forall o, F (sup R) o -> exists i, F (R i) o.
Definition monotone (F : env -> den) := forall r s, ele r s -> dle (F r) (F s).

Local Lemma cont_const d : continuous (fun _ => d).
Proof. intros I R [[i _] _] o H; now exists i. Qed.

Local Lemma cont_var v : continuous (fun r => r v).
Proof. intros I R HD o H; exact H. Qed.

Local Lemma cont_guard F G o :
  monotone F -> monotone G -> continuous F -> continuous G ->
  continuous (fun r => dguard (F r) o (G r)).
Proof.
  intros HF HG CF CG I R HD p [H1 H2].
  destruct (CF _ _ HD _ H1) as [i Hi], (CG _ _ HD _ H2) as [j Hj].
  destruct (proj2 HD i j) as (k & Hik & Hjk).
  exists k; split; eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma cont_union F G : continuous F -> continuous G ->
  continuous (fun r => dunion (F r) (G r)).
Proof.
  intros CF CG I R HD o [H|H].
  - destruct (CF _ _ HD _ H) as [i Hi]; exists i; now left.
  - destruct (CG _ _ HD _ H) as [i Hi]; exists i; now right.
Qed.

Local Lemma cont_node n F G : continuous F -> continuous G ->
  continuous (fun r => dnode n (F r) (G r)).
Proof.
  intros CF CG I R HD [m|[] o|xs o|x] H; simpl in H.
  - destruct HD as [[i _] _]; now exists i.
  - exact (CF _ _ HD _ H).
  - exact (CG _ _ HD _ H).
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
Qed.

Local Lemma cont_field b F : continuous F -> continuous (fun r => dfield b (F r)).
Proof. intros CF I R HD o H; exact (CF _ _ HD _ H). Qed.

Local Lemma cont_app F G :
  monotone F -> monotone G -> continuous F -> continuous G ->
  continuous (fun r => dapp (F r) (G r)).
Proof.
  intros HF HG CF CG I R HD o (xs & H & Hxs).
  destruct (CF _ _ HD _ H) as [i Hi].
  destruct (directed_collect R HD G HG xs) as [j Hj].
  { intros p Hp; apply CG with (R := R); auto. }
  destruct (proj2 HD i j) as (k & Hik & Hjk).
  exists k, xs; split; eauto using dle_trans.
Qed.

Local Lemma cont_push F G :
  (forall r s, ele r s -> dle (meaning r F) (meaning s F)) ->
  continuous (fun r => meaning r F) ->
  monotone G -> continuous G ->
  continuous (fun r => meaning (push r (G r)) F).
Proof.
  intros MF CF MG CG I R HD o H.
  set (S := fun i => push (R i) (G (R i))).
  assert (DS : directed S).
  { destruct HD as [Hi Hd]; split; auto. intros i j.
    destruct (Hd i j) as (k & Hik & Hjk).
    exists k; split; apply push_le; auto. }
  assert (HS : ele (push (sup R) (G (sup R))) (sup S)).
  { intros [[|k]|x|x] p Hp; try exact Hp.
    exact (CG _ _ HD _ Hp). }
  exact (CF _ _ DS _ (MF _ _ HS _ H)).
Qed.

Local Lemma cont_lam F :
  (forall d, continuous (fun r => F r d)) ->
  continuous (fun r => dlam (F r)).
Proof. intros C I R HD [n|s o|xs o|x] H; try contradiction; exact (C _ _ _ HD _ H). Qed.

Local Lemma meaning_cont e : continuous (fun r => meaning r e).
Proof.
  induction e; cbn [meaning];
    unfold dcase, dprod, dsum, dpi, dinj, dpair, dite;
    eauto 10 using meaning_le, cont_const, cont_var, cont_node, cont_app,
      cont_push, cont_lam, cont_field, cont_guard, cont_union, field_le, dle_refl.
Qed.

Local Lemma meaning_beta r e a :
  deq (dapp (dlam (fun d => meaning (push r d) e)) a)
      (meaning (push r a) e).
Proof.
  apply eq_of_le.
  - intros o (xs & H & Hxs); eapply meaning_le; [apply push_le | exact H];
      eauto using dle_refl.
  - intros o H.
    set (I := { xs : list observation | dle (dlist xs) a }).
    set (R := fun i : I => push r (dlist (proj1_sig i))).
    assert (HD : directed R).
    { split.
      - exists (exist _ [] (ltac:(firstorder))); exact I.
      - intros [xs Hxs] [ys Hys].
        assert (Hboth : dle (dlist (xs ++ ys)) a).
        { intros p Hp; apply in_app_or in Hp; intuition. }
        exists (exist _ (xs ++ ys) Hboth); split; apply push_le;
          try (intro; apply dle_refl); intros p Hp; apply in_or_app; auto. }
    assert (He : ele (push r a) (sup R)).
    { intros [[|k]|x|x] p Hp.
      - assert (Hone : dle (dlist [p]) a) by (intros q [<-|[]]; exact Hp).
        exists (exist _ [p] Hone); now left.
      - destruct HD as [[i _] _]; now exists i.
      - destruct HD as [[i _] _]; now exists i.
      - destruct HD as [[i _] _]; now exists i. }
    destruct (meaning_cont e _ _ HD _ (meaning_le e _ _ He _ H)) as [[xs Hxs] Hbody].
    now exists xs.
Qed.
EOF

Local Lemma deq_le a b : deq a b -> dle a b.
Proof. firstorder. Qed.

Local Lemma eq_of_le a b : dle a b -> dle b a -> deq a b.
Proof. firstorder. Qed.

Local Lemma meaning_eq e r s : eeq r s -> deq (meaning r e) (meaning s e).
Proof.
  intros H; apply eq_of_le; apply meaning_le; intro i;
    apply deq_le; [apply H | symmetry; apply H].
Qed.

Local Lemma push_eq r s a b :
  eeq r s -> deq a b -> eeq (push r a) (push s b).
Proof. intros Hr H i; destruct i as [[|k]|x|x]; simpl; auto. Qed.

Definition directed {I : Type} (R : I -> env) :=
  (exists i, True) /\\ forall i j, exists k, ele (R i) (R k) /\\ ele (R j) (R k).
Definition sup {I : Type} (R : I -> env) : env := fun s o => exists i, R i s o.

Local Lemma directed_collect {I : Type} (R : I -> env) (HD : directed R)
    (F : env -> den) (HM : forall r s, ele r s -> dle (F r) (F s)) xs :
  (forall o, List.In o xs -> exists i, F (R i) o) ->
  exists i, dle (dlist xs) (F (R i)).
Proof.
  destruct HD as [[i _] HD]; induction xs as [|o xs IH]; intros H.
  - exists i; firstorder.
  - destruct (H o) as (j & Hj); [left; reflexivity|].
    destruct IH as (k & Hk); [intros; apply H; right; assumption|].
    destruct (HD j k) as (m & Hjm & Hkm).
    exists m; intros p [<-|Hp]; eauto.
Qed.

Definition continuous (F : env -> den) :=
  forall (I : Type) (R : I -> env), directed R ->
    forall o, F (sup R) o -> exists i, F (R i) o.
Definition monotone (F : env -> den) := forall r s, ele r s -> dle (F r) (F s).

Local Lemma cont_const d : continuous (fun _ => d).
Proof. intros I R [[i _] _] o H; now exists i. Qed.

Local Lemma cont_var v : continuous (fun r => r v).
Proof. intros I R HD o H; exact H. Qed.

Local Lemma cont_guard F G o :
  monotone F -> monotone G -> continuous F -> continuous G ->
  continuous (fun r => dguard (F r) o (G r)).
Proof.
  intros HF HG CF CG I R HD p [H1 H2].
  destruct (CF _ _ HD _ H1) as [i Hi], (CG _ _ HD _ H2) as [j Hj].
  destruct (proj2 HD i j) as (k & Hik & Hjk).
  exists k; split; eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma cont_union F G : continuous F -> continuous G ->
  continuous (fun r => dunion (F r) (G r)).
Proof.
  intros CF CG I R HD o [H|H].
  - destruct (CF _ _ HD _ H) as [i Hi]; exists i; now left.
  - destruct (CG _ _ HD _ H) as [i Hi]; exists i; now right.
Qed.

Local Lemma cont_node n F G : continuous F -> continuous G ->
  continuous (fun r => dnode n (F r) (G r)).
Proof.
  intros CF CG I R HD [m|[] o|xs o|x] H; simpl in H.
  - destruct HD as [[i _] _]; now exists i.
  - exact (CF _ _ HD _ H).
  - exact (CG _ _ HD _ H).
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
Qed.

Local Lemma cont_field b F : continuous F -> continuous (fun r => dfield b (F r)).
Proof. intros CF I R HD o H; exact (CF _ _ HD _ H). Qed.

Local Lemma cont_app F G :
  monotone F -> monotone G -> continuous F -> continuous G ->
  continuous (fun r => dapp (F r) (G r)).
Proof.
  intros HF HG CF CG I R HD o (xs & H & Hxs).
  destruct (CF _ _ HD _ H) as [i Hi].
  destruct (directed_collect R HD G HG xs) as [j Hj].
  { intros p Hp; apply CG with (R := R); auto. }
  destruct (proj2 HD i j) as (k & Hik & Hjk).
  exists k, xs; split; eauto using dle_trans.
Qed.

Local Lemma cont_push F G :
  (forall r s, ele r s -> dle (meaning r F) (meaning s F)) ->
  continuous (fun r => meaning r F) ->
  monotone G -> continuous G ->
  continuous (fun r => meaning (push r (G r)) F).
Proof.
  intros MF CF MG CG I R HD o H.
  set (S := fun i => push (R i) (G (R i))).
  assert (DS : directed S).
  { destruct HD as [Hi Hd]; split; auto. intros i j.
    destruct (Hd i j) as (k & Hik & Hjk).
    exists k; split; apply push_le; auto. }
  assert (HS : ele (push (sup R) (G (sup R))) (sup S)).
  { intros [[|k]|x|x] p Hp; try exact Hp.
    exact (CG _ _ HD _ Hp). }
  exact (CF _ _ DS _ (MF _ _ HS _ H)).
Qed.

Local Lemma cont_lam F :
  (forall d, continuous (fun r => F r d)) ->
  continuous (fun r => dlam (F r)).
Proof. intros C I R HD [n|s o|xs o|x] H; try contradiction; exact (C _ _ _ HD _ H). Qed.

Local Lemma meaning_cont e : continuous (fun r => meaning r e).
Proof.
  induction e; cbn [meaning];
    unfold dcase, dprod, dsum, dpi, dinj, dpair, dite;
    eauto 10 using meaning_le, cont_const, cont_var, cont_node, cont_app,
      cont_push, cont_lam, cont_field, cont_guard, cont_union, field_le, dle_refl.
Qed.

Local Lemma meaning_beta r e a :
  deq (dapp (dlam (fun d => meaning (push r d) e)) a)
      (meaning (push r a) e).
Proof.
  apply eq_of_le.
  - intros o (xs & H & Hxs); eapply meaning_le; [apply push_le | exact H];
      eauto using dle_refl.
  - intros o H.
    set (I := { xs : list observation | dle (dlist xs) a }).
    set (R := fun i : I => push r (dlist (proj1_sig i))).
    assert (HD : directed R).
    { split.
      - exists (exist _ [] (ltac:(firstorder))); exact I.
      - intros [xs Hxs] [ys Hys].
        assert (Hboth : dle (dlist (xs ++ ys)) a).
        { intros p Hp; apply in_app_or in Hp; intuition. }
        exists (exist _ (xs ++ ys) Hboth); split; apply push_le;
          try (intro; apply dle_refl); intros p Hp; apply in_or_app; auto. }
    assert (He : ele (push r a) (sup R)).
    { intros [[|k]|x|x] p Hp.
      - assert (Hone : dle (dlist [p]) a) by (intros q [<-|[]]; exact Hp).
        exists (exist _ [p] Hone); now left.
      - destruct HD as [[i _] _]; now exists i.
      - destruct HD as [[i _] _]; now exists i.
      - destruct HD as [[i _] _]; now exists i. }
    destruct (meaning_cont e _ _ HD _ (meaning_le e _ _ He _ H)) as [[xs Hxs] Hbody].
    now exists xs.
Qed.

Fixpoint scoped (k : nat) (e : expr) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | EBVar n => n < k

  | EApp a b | EPair a b | EProd a b | ESum _ a b | EInj _ _ a b =>
      scoped k a /\\ scoped k b
  | EBoxedInj _ a b => scoped 0 a /\\ scoped 0 b
  | EIte _ c a b | EMux c a b => scoped k c /\\ scoped k a /\\ scoped k b
  | EProj _ a | EFold _ a | EUnfold _ a | ESec a | ETape a => scoped k a
  | _ => True
  end.

Fixpoint fvars (e : expr) : aset :=
  match e with
  | EFVar x => {[ x ]}
  | EPi _ a b | EAbs _ a b | ELet a b | EApp a b | EPair a b
  | EProd a b | ESum _ a b | EInj _ _ a b | EBoxedInj _ a b =>
      fvars a ∪ fvars b
  | ECase _ c a b | EIte _ c a b | EMux c a b =>
      fvars c ∪ fvars a ∪ fvars b
  | EProj _ a | EFold _ a | EUnfold _ a | ESec a | ETape a => fvars a
  | _ => ∅
  end.

Local Lemma scoped_mono e k n : scoped k e -> k <= n -> scoped n e.
Proof.

Qed.

Local Lemma open_scoped e k s :

    lia.

Local Lemma close_scoped e k x :

Definition globals_only (r : env) : env :=
  fun i => match i with Global _ => r i | _ => dzero end.

Definition global_operator (Σ : gctx) (r : env) : env :=
  fun i => match i with
           | Global x =>
               match Σ "'!! x with
               | Some (DFun _ e) => meaning r e
               | Some (DOADT _ e) => dlam (fun d => meaning (push r d) e)
               | Some (DADT _) => dnominal x
               | None => dzero
               end
           | _ => dzero
           end.

Fixpoint approximation Σ n : env :=
  match n with 0 => ezero | S k => global_operator Σ (approximation Σ k) end.
Definition global_meaning Σ := sup (approximation Σ).
Definition fixed_globals Σ r :=
  forall x, deq (r (Global x)) (global_meaning Σ (Global x)).

Local Lemma global_operator_le Σ r s :
  ele r s -> ele (global_operator Σ r) (global_operator Σ s).
Proof.
  intros H [k|x|x]; try apply dle_refl.
  unfold global_operator; destruct (Σ !! x) as [[t|t e|t e]|];
    eauto using dle_refl, meaning_le, lam_le, push_le.
Qed.

Local Lemma approximation_next Σ n :
  ele (approximation Σ n) (approximation Σ (S n)).
Proof. induction n; [intros i o [] | exact (global_operator_le _ _ _ IHn)]. Qed.

Local Lemma approximation_le Σ n m :
  n <= m -> ele (approximation Σ n) (approximation Σ m).
Proof.
  induction 1; [intro; apply dle_refl|].
  intro i; eapply dle_trans; [apply IHle | apply approximation_next].
Qed.

Local Lemma approximation_directed Σ : directed (approximation Σ).
Proof.
  split; [now exists 0 | intros n m; exists (n + m); split; apply approximation_le; lia].
Qed.

Local Lemma global_operator_cont Σ i : continuous (fun r => global_operator Σ r i).
Proof.
  destruct i as [k|x|x]; try apply cont_const.
  unfold global_operator; destruct (Σ !! x) as [[t|t e|t e]|];
    eauto using cont_const, meaning_cont, cont_lam, cont_push, cont_const,
     meaning_le, push_le, dle_refl.
Qed.

Local Lemma global_fixed Σ : eeq (global_meaning Σ) (global_operator Σ (global_meaning Σ)).
Proof.
  intro i; apply eq_of_le.
  - intros o ([|n] & H); [contradiction|].
    exact (global_operator_le Σ _ _ (fun j p Hp => ex_intro _ n Hp) i o H).
  - intros o H.
    destruct (global_operator_cont Σ i _ _ (approximation_directed Σ) _ H) as [n Hn].
    now exists (S n).
Qed.

Local Lemma global_fun Σ r x T e :
  gctx_typing Σ -> fixed_globals Σ r -> Σ !! x = Some (DFun T e) ->
  deq (meaning r (EGVar x)) (meaning r e).
Proof.
  intros HG Hr Hx; pose proof (gdef_scope _ _ _ HG Hx) as [Hs Hfv].
  cbn [meaning]; etransitivity; [apply Hr|].
  etransitivity; [apply global_fixed|].
  unfold global_operator; rewrite Hx.
  apply meaning_agree with (k := 0); [exact Hs|].
  repeat split; try lia.
  - intros y Hy; apply Hfv, elem_of_empty in Hy; contradiction.
  - intro; symmetry; apply Hr.
Qed.

Local Lemma global_oadt Σ r X t e :
  gctx_typing Σ -> fixed_globals Σ r -> Σ !! X = Some (DOADT t e) ->
  deq (meaning r (EGVar X)) (dlam (fun d => meaning (push r d) e)).
Proof.
  intros HG Hr Hx; pose proof (gdef_scope _ _ _ HG Hx) as [Hs Hfv].
  cbn [meaning]; etransitivity; [apply Hr|].
  etransitivity; [apply global_fixed|].
  unfold global_operator; rewrite Hx.
  apply lam_eq; intro d; apply meaning_agree with (k := 1); [exact Hs|].
  apply agrees_push; [|reflexivity].
  repeat split; try lia.
  - intros y Hy; apply Hfv, elem_of_empty in Hy; contradiction.

  etransitivity; [apply global_fixed|].
  unfold global_operator; now rewrite Hx.
Qed.

Local Lemma pared_scope Σ e e'"' :
  gctx_typing Σ -> pared Σ e e' -> scoped 0 e /\\ scoped 0 e'.
Proof.
  intros HG H; induction H;
    repeat match goal with
    | H : scoped 0 _ /\\ scoped 0 _ |- _ => destruct H
    | H : forall x, x ∉ ?L -> scoped 0 _ /\\ scoped 0 _ |- _ =>
        let HL := fresh in let HR := fresh in
        pose proof (cofinite_scoped L _ (fun x Hx => proj1 (H x Hx))) as HL;
        pose proof (cofinite_scoped L _ (fun x Hx => proj2 (H x Hx))) as HR;
        clear H
    | H : lc _ |- _ => apply lc_scoped in H
    | H : otval _ |- _ => apply otval_scope in H as [H _]
    | H : oval _ |- _ => apply oval_scope in H as [H _]
    | H : ovalty _ _ |- _ => apply ovalty_scope in H as [?H ?H]
    | H : Σ "'!! _ = Some (DFun _ _) |- _ =>
        let HS := fresh in pose proof (gdef_scope _ _ _ HG H) as [HS _]; clear H
    | H : Σ !! _ = Some (DOADT _ _) |- _ =>
        let HS := fresh in pose proof (gdef_scope _ _ _ HG H) as [HS _]; clear H
    end;
    cbn [scoped]; unfold open in *;
    repeat split; try exact I; eauto 5 using open_scoped;
    destruct b; simpl in *; intuition eauto using open_scoped.

  | etransitivity; [apply meaning_eq, push_eq; [reflexivity|auto]|auto]

Definition global_meaning Σ := sup (approximation Σ).

Local Lemma global_operator_le Σ r s :

Local Lemma approximation_next Σ n :

Local Lemma approximation_le Σ n m :

Local Lemma subst_inert e x u : x ∉ fvars e -> subst x u e = e.
Proof.

    try solve [f_equal; eauto; set_solver].
  destruct (decide (x = x0)); [subst; set_solver|reflexivity].
Qed.

Local Lemma subst_scope e k x u : scoped k e -> scoped 0 u -> scoped k (subst x u e).
Proof.
  revert k; induction e; intros n H Hu; simpl in *; try solve [intuition eauto].
  destruct (decide (x = x0)); simpl; eauto using scoped_mono, Nat.le_0_l.

  scoped 0 u -> x <> y ->
